hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the way back is south

wards.name: the barrow door
wards.denied: A slab across the mound's throat, cut to fit and settled a thousand years into fitting. Shift it, or hold the warden's key, and not otherwise.
wards.opened: The slab grinds aside and the mound breathes out.

spots.line: The mound. Grass over it like anywhere else, and nothing grows on the crown.
Standing stones, set in a ring nobody has finished counting.
Offerings, left recently, by people who would deny leaving them.
The turf is worn to earth here. Everyone stops at exactly this distance.

chests.line: A satchel under a leaning stone, out of the rain and out of mind.
Coin pressed into the turf, one piece at a time, over years.
Inside the mound, where the grave goods were laid out for somebody who did not stay.

people.name: Maerd the Barrow-keeper
chatter: They put it under a hill so people would leave it alone. People did not.
I do not stop anyone. I write down who went in and when.
The stones were here first. The mound was put among them, not the other way about.
You will hear it settle. That is all it is. Mostly.

people.name: Ninnet, who leaves flowers
chatter: My great-grandmother did this walk. I do not know for who.
You are not supposed to take anything out. You will anyway.
If it goes cold in there, come straight back out. Straight out.
